shop.title: Start with what you see in the mirror
shop.lede: Pigmentation, breakouts, dryness, fine lines — every skin has its own story. What you see here is what has worked on our clients' skin in the clinic: not everything on the market, but what we chose.

meta.title: Professional skincare shop | Forlle'd, Storyderm, Thalgo
meta.description: Professional skincare from the official Forlle'd Japan representative in Mashhad. For pigmentation, acne, hydration, barrier repair and ageing — shipped across Iran.

concerns.title: What does your skin need right now?
concerns.lede: Rather than working through dozens of brands, pick the concern. Each path leads to products chosen for that one problem.

authenticity.title: Genuine Forlle'd, straight from Japan
authenticity.body: The worry is fair: the market is full of counterfeits. We are the official Forlle'd Japan representative in Mashhad, and every product arrives through the official route. If you would like, we will check any package with you.

brands.title: The brands we work with
brands.lede: Each one is here because we have seen what it does on skin.

closing.title: Not sure which one is right for your skin?
closing.body: You do not have to guess. Send us a message and tell us what your skin is doing — we will point you in the right direction, whether or not you buy anything.

mosaic.title: The calm of the corridor, not the noise of the marketplace
mosaic.body: Our work is unhurried. Skin is not fixed in a night, and it is not fixed by advertising; it is fixed by a simple routine you actually keep to. What we sell here is what we use in the clinic — nothing more.
